international.title: Van Hollen takes aim at Schumer as Democrats face first big test after midterms – US politics live
international.summary: Senator Van Hollen says midterm results show Americans want change in Washington, and Democrats need new leadership to deliver that Sign up for the Breaking News US email Dozens of protesters with the Sunrise Movement, a youth climate organization, were arrested after staging a sit-in inside Senate minority leader Chuck Schumer’s Washington DC office Thursday. According to the Sunrise Movement, 54 people were arrested, among a few hundred who joined the protest from across the country, including some from New York, which Schumer represents. On its Instagram, the group is fundraising $24,000 to cover the bail fees and any potential legal fees for those arrested. Continue reading...
